claims.claim: India's government notified CAFE-3 norms setting fuel-efficiency and carbon-emission limits for passenger vehicles from April 1, 2027, to March 31, 2032.
claims.episode_span: Those limits run from April 1, 2027, to March 31, 2032
claims.source_title: Government notifies new CAFE-3 norms for passenger vehicles
claims.supporting_quote: The government has notified new Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE-3) norms that will set fuel-efficiency and carbon-emission limits for passenger vehicles from April 1, 2027, to March 31, 2032.

claims.claim: The final CAFE-3 norms eliminated a draft concession for petrol cars under 909 kg and raised the reference weight from 1,082 kg to 1,229 kg, about 13.6 percent.
claims.episode_span: lift the reference weight from 1,082 kilograms to 1,229 kilograms
claims.source_title: Government notifies new CAFE-3 norms for passenger vehicles
claims.supporting_quote: The reference weight has been increased from 1,082 kg under existing norms to 1,229 kg under new CAFE norms, an increase of around 13.6%
